measurement_capture.scope: Sequential resource/executor/storage snapshots after workload completion, before validation; not an atomic read. GC and warning collectors close at capture end.

validation.scope: Durable order, retained cold content hashes, projection head and card checks; includes awaited validation observer persistence. Excluded from workload duration and captured counters.

premeasurement.scope: Kernel boot and synthetic fixture seeding; not part of steady mixed window

slow_observations.scope: last completed slow worker invocations; queue time separate from elapsed
slow_observations.lock_note: measured lock sections are inclusive; nested hold intervals may overlap
slow_observations.lock_events_note: last64 measured sections per slow invocation; total includes evicted sections; outer hold is the union of outermost measured sections, not CPU time; hold includes unlock and scheduling around it; release_ms separates that interval and is not pure unlock CPU or proven held time

premeasurement.acceptance: reported separately; full server cold boot remains unaccepted

retained_cold_verification.scope: Postmeasurement verification of every retained cold object; outside workload samples/counter snapshot, adds local read/decompression work.

fixture.limits: single process, local disposable storage, synthetic providers, no external peer/provider time

slow_operations.scope: last completed slow worker invocations; queue time separate from elapsed
slow_operations.lock_note: measured lock sections are inclusive; nested hold intervals may overlap
slow_operations.lock_events_note: last64 measured sections per slow invocation; total includes evicted sections; outer hold is the union of outermost measured sections, not CPU time; hold includes unlock and scheduling around it; release_ms separates that interval and is not pure unlock CPU or proven held time

filesystem_phase_scope: Exact completed-worker logical counters during measurement, separate from last256 distributions and premeasurement boot/seeding. Wall intervals overlap and are not physical disk bytes or native busy proof.

runtime_window_note: Counters/windows include boot and fixture seeding; counter deltas and explicit latency samples cover only the declared measurement scenario.
